item.title: Context Language Models: Self-Managing Context to Improve Performance and Reduce Compute Costs
item.description:
Researchers from Meta, MIT, and the University of Washington introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), a new approach that enables language models to manage and edit their own context rather than relying on predefined mechanisms for summarization, compression, and information retrieval, reporting substantial gains in both performance and computational efficiency.

By Sergio De Simone

item.title: AWS Introduces Enhanced Custom Event Buses for EventBridge
item.description:
AWS recently announced enhanced custom event buses for Amazon EventBridge, allowing organizations to share a centralized bus across accounts with ordered delivery, simplified subscriber management, event replay, content-based deduplication, and a new publisher/subscriber-based pricing model.

By Renato Losio
